accounting.rationale: Lists the five intrinsic types and points to 7.4. The individual integer, real, complex, character, and logical value/literal/operation plans are owned by the 7.4 catalogues.
The paragraph combines the common KIND parameter statement with CHARACTER LEN; the fine units keep representation-method and string-length concepts separate.
All intrinsic types have KIND. 7.2 and 7.4.1 own type-parameter values, default kind behavior, and supported-kind restrictions; this overview does not create byte-width or encoding expectations.
CHARACTER additionally has LEN determining character string length. Character length forms and value effects are owned by 7.4.4.1-.2 and related CHARACTER catalogues.

review_rationale: Source registration for 5.4 and 5.4.1-5.4.6 of the Clause 5 overview: type, data value, data entity, data object, definition of objects and pointers, reference and array (batch249). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; overview definitions are cross-referenced to specific owning facets in Clauses 7-19. Source accounting only.
